name: omni-ai-framework
description: Claude Code plugins: omni workflow skills, review subagent, safety hooks, plus pinned third-party defaults (superpowers, playwright-cli)

plugins.name: omni-core
plugins.description: Explore-plan-implement-verify workflow skills, spec interviews, skill authoring, and an adversarial review subagent

plugins.name: omni-guardrails
plugins.description: PreToolUse hooks that block catastrophic shell commands and ask before history-rewriting git operations

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Third-party (obra/superpowers, MIT): brainstorming, planning, TDD, systematic debugging, subagent-driven development, code review. Pinned to the commit Anthropic's official marketplace lists.

plugins.name: playwright-cli
plugins.description: Third-party (microsoft/playwright-cli, Apache-2.0): browser automation and testing skill driving the playwright-cli command (installs it with npm when missing).
